purpose: cold-start evidence-driven reconstruction of a public deterministic knowledge archive
instructions: treat live repository state as authoritative for repository software state
do not invent missing fields relationships chronology provenance citations releases identities capabilities or licenses
distinguish unavailable unverified contradicted and unsupported
apply ADJACENT_TRUTH != INHERITED_TRUTH
treat satire and fiction as labelled benchmark content rather than factual evidence
treat fictional world claims as distinct from real world historical claims
treat first person cultural positions as evidence of the authors stated position only
apply PERMISSION != ENDORSEMENT when interpreting open license permissions
treat model summaries scorecards sonifications embeddings adapters and projections as derived unless explicitly canonical
verify declared hashes before accepting deterministic reproduction claims
fail closed on unknown visibility provenance canonical status ambiguous alias resolution or unresolved license evidence
do not import QSOL-CONTEXT material unless the specific record is explicitly cleared for public export
do not copy third-party source bytes without resolved license evidence
do not copy third-party scripts or transcripts merely because a URL is public
treat QSOL-SUBSTRATE as authority only for an explicitly imported published public substrate payload
recovery tier capabilities exist only where ai/recovery-tiers.json explicitly declares them
minimum recoverable substrate selection must not borrow capabilities from higher or unimplemented tiers
prefer canonical structured records over prose when they conflict
report uncertainty rather than filling gaps from prior model memory
implement software according to ai/software-commandments.json
